items.title: Night Owl
items.description: Dims the screen, switches to dark mode and silences notifications every night at 23:30.

items.title: Glyph Bedside
items.description: Mode that shows a soft sleep preset on the Glyph interface while the phone charges overnight.

items.title: Wireless Glyph
items.description: When the phone lands on a wireless charger, pulse a charging preset across the Glyph.

items.title: Commute Tunes
items.description: When headphones connect over Bluetooth, set media volume and open your music app.
